Application Data.NAME: Elegant Timepieces Boutique
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Elegant Timepieces Boutique specializes in the retail sale of high-quality jewelry and watches, focusing on both exquisite craftsmanship and contemporary designs. Our store features a curated selection of luxury timepieces and fine jewelry, sourced from reputable manufacturers. We maintain a secure, alarmed premises with 24/7 video surveillance to protect our high-value inventory, which is well-documented with up-to-date appraisals. We do not engage in on-site rentals of jewelry or watches, nor do we offer in-store classes or workshops, thereby minimizing liability exposure. Our commitment to customer service is paramount, and we ensure all staff receive training in security protocols and loss prevention strategies.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 15, 2023, a break-in occurred at Elegant Timepieces Boutique, resulting in the theft of several high-value watches. The estimated loss from the incident amounts to $15,000. The theft was reported promptly to law enforcement and the status of the case is currently under investigation.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL Class 5 Safe, Grade B, High-Security Rating
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: 24/7 security monitoring with a full-time security guard during business hours, along with a high-security UL-rated safe for high-value inventory.
